about: The crow's hop: four poses of the body's own Hop (three frames planted, both feet swinging back, then a low skim with a wing flare: about 0.95 m a hop), side-on, down and up, at the kernel's walk of 190 ms a tile (HUNTING 2). Rendered airborne (one floor a cycle), so the skim leaves the ground. Four poses a loop (DECISIONS 2026-10-29).
